clue.text: Assign, if I can, certain fragment's meaning…

indicators.note: a fragment of the opening words is all that is wanted, so the answer runs inside them

parts.note: the opening words of the clue, read straight through, hold the answer

explanation.surface: Someone puzzling over what a piece of a certain text is meant to say.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts after the AS of Assign and stops before the RTAIN of certain, ignoring the commas.
explanation.definitionFit: Significance is the import or sense something carries, a close synonym of meaning as a noun.

clue.text: Unusual pastime: creating an online guide

indicators.note: an unusual version of the word pastime has its letters put in a different order

parts.note: the letters of this word are used as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: An odd hobby: building a guide for a website.
explanation.definitionFit: A site map is a page listing a website's pages, a navigational aid for visitors on the web.

clue.text: Ultimately starting to smell like feta

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the next word, starting

parts.note: its last letter is taken
to reek is to smell strongly and unpleasantly

explanation.surface: A cheese that ends up smelling strong, as feta might.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ultimately starting' reads as an odd adverb pair, but it means the end of the word starting.
explanation.definitionFit: Feta is a cheese from Greece, so it is Greek in origin.

clue.text: Emphasize it with unnatural zeal around here (in Marseille)

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go around the French word
an unnatural form of zeal has its letters rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
ici is French for here, and Marseille is a French city

explanation.surface: Someone stressing a point with excessive enthusiasm while in southern France.
explanation.definitionFit: Italicizing text is a typographic way to stress it, so it means to give emphasis.

clue.text: Arrange leis here!

indicators.note: to arrange the letters of leis is to put them in a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: An invitation to drape flower garlands on visitors here.
explanation.walkthrough: Leis are Hawaiian flower garlands, given on islands, so the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An isle is an island, such as one in Hawaii where garlands of flowers greet arrivals.

clue.text: Luring abominable giant outside a piece of land

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit outside the piece of land
an abominable giant suggests the Abominable Snowman, but here the word signals the letters of giant are mangled

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
a tract is an area of land

explanation.surface: A monstrous giant tempting someone off a plot of ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Attracting is drawing someone in, which is what luring or enticing does.

clue.text: Brought back a pain in the neck — largely, more or less

indicators.note: brought back means the assembled letters are read in the other direction

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: largely means most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: a crick is a painful stiffness in the neck

explanation.surface: A stiff neck that has returned and is, roughly speaking, a big one.
explanation.definitionFit: Circa is the Latin word placed before dates meaning approximately, as in about 1600.

clue.text: Occurrence incorporated one small depression

parts.note: Inc. is the abbreviation for incorporated, used after US company names
I is the Roman numeral for one
a dent is a small hollow pressed into a surface

explanation.surface: A business filing reports that a company was formed during a minor slump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small depression' reads like an economic dip but is a physical dent.
explanation.definitionFit: An incident is an event or happening, a synonym for an occurrence.

clue.text: Neglect to fake the slightest bit of turmoil

parts.note: to forge is to fake a document or signature

indicators.note: the slightest bit of a word is its first letter alone

parts.note: its first letter is taken

explanation.surface: Someone failing to pretend even a little distress.
explanation.definitionFit: To forget something is to fail to attend to it, which is what neglecting means.

clue.text: … to mysterious alien: "It could get clipped"

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: a mysterious version of alien has its letters jumbled

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Continuing from the previous clue, someone addresses a strange visitor about something trimmed.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links the surface to 1-across but plays no part in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Nails on the feet are regularly trimmed with clippers, so this is a playful description by example.

clue.text: Western sidekick keeps gold in northern city

indicators.note: the sidekick keeps the gold inside him

parts.note: Tonto is the Lone Ranger's companion in the Western radio and TV series
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A cowboy's companion holds treasure in a city up north.
explanation.definitionFit: Toronto is Canada's largest city, north of the United States where the puzzle is published.

clue.text: Barker and Richards almost hit the big time

parts.note: Ma Barker was a notorious 1930s American gang matriarch

indicators.note: almost means the name falls one letter short at the end

parts.note: Keith Richards is the Rolling Stones guitarist

explanation.surface: Two famous people nearly achieving stardom.
explanation.walkthrough: Barker and Richards look like a pair of entertainers, but each is a separate surname giving a first name.
explanation.definitionFit: To make it is an idiom for achieving success or fame.

clue.text: Coping with husband getting older

parts.note: man is used for husband, as in man and wife
aging is growing older

explanation.surface: Someone dealing with a spouse who is growing old.
explanation.definitionFit: Managing is getting by or handling a situation, a synonym of coping.

clue.text: Alcohol swallowed next to prig — for the most part, that's the last thing you want

indicators.note: the drink swallows the other pieces, taking them inside

parts.note: booze is informal for alcoholic drink
by can mean beside, as in sitting by the fire

indicators.note: for the most part means all but the last letter of the word

parts.note: a self-righteous person

explanation.surface: A self-righteous person's drink spilled beside them, which nobody wants.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a joke: the prize for coming last is literally the last thing you want.
explanation.definitionFit: A booby prize is given to whoever finishes last in a contest, so it is a reward nobody hopes for.

clue.text: Favorite idiosyncrasy: grass skirt

parts.note: a pet is a favorite, as in teacher's pet
a tic is a habitual quirk
the oat is a cereal grass

explanation.surface: A fashion entry: a favorite quirk is a grass skirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A petticoat is an underskirt worn beneath a dress.

clue.text: Curry contains a unit tainted with metal

indicators.note: the actor's first name contains the reworked letters

parts.note: Tim Curry is the actor from The Rocky Horror Picture Show

indicators.note: tainted letters are spoiled, so the letters of a unit are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A spicy dish with one portion contaminated by metal.
explanation.walkthrough: Curry looks like food, but it is the actor.
explanation.definitionFit: Titanium is a strong, light metallic element used in aircraft and implants.

clue.text: Expert with a diminished third dimension

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: diminished means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: depth is the third dimension after length and width

explanation.surface: A specialist who lacks a full sense of three-dimensional space.
explanation.definitionFit: Adept as a noun means a skilled person, a master or virtuoso.

clue.text: Chap featured in an IRA retrospective in The Nation

indicators.note: the chap is featured inside the other letters
a retrospective looks backward, so these letters are read in reverse

parts.note: IRA is used as written, with an
gent is short for gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: A man appears in a look back at the Irish Republican Army, printed in this very magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Nation' names the magazine publishing the puzzle; only Nation defines, and La Nación is also a famous Argentine paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentina is a country in South America, and a nation is a country.

clue.text: Attractive person heard from RS's neighbors?

indicators.note: heard means the letters are spoken out loud to give a word

parts.note: Q comes before R and T after S in the alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone describing an attractive individual as reported by the people next door.
explanation.walkthrough: RS reads like someone's initials, but it is two alphabet letters whose outer neighbors are wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutie is an informal term for a good-looking or charming person.

clue.text: Admits company tops off

indicators.note: off means the letters of tops are out of order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A business removes its senior people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tops off' reads as removing the tops, but off signals a rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To cop to something is an informal American idiom for confessing it.

clue.text: Audibly receive a title in the dark

indicators.note: audibly means the phrase is spoken, giving a word with the same sound

parts.note: to be knighted is to receive the title Sir

explanation.surface: Someone is given a knighthood at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Benighted means ignorant or unenlightened, and literally overtaken by night.

clue.text: Novelist misspelled "Deer Sir"

indicators.note: a misspelled version of the greeting has its letters rearranged

parts.note: the quoted greeting supplies the letters as written

explanation.surface: Someone noticing a typo in a letter's opening greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Theodore Dreiser was the American author of Sister Carrie and An American Tragedy.

clue.text: Writer to run off with faithful wife

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument
to elope is to run off secretly to marry

explanation.surface: An author planning to run away with a devoted spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's eloping with a faithful wife is ironic, since Penelope was famously loyal.
explanation.definitionFit: Penelope, in Homer's Odyssey, waited twenty years for Odysseus, the model of a loyal spouse.

clue.text: Grassland coming up over everything…

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: on can mean over or upon
all means everything

explanation.surface: Grass springing up across the whole landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: A llano is a broad grassy plain in Latin America or the American Southwest.

clue.text: Do battle with rioting gang, within the limits of endurance

indicators.note: the reworked letters go within the outer pair
the limits of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: its outer letters are taken

indicators.note: a rioting gang is disordered, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Fighting a violent mob until one can hold out no longer.
explanation.definitionFit: To engage an enemy is to enter combat with them, a military sense.

clue.text: …beside crazy Anglo

indicators.note: a crazy version of Anglo has its letters mixed up

parts.note: this word supplies the letters as written

explanation.surface: Continuing from the previous clue: next to an unhinged Englishman.
explanation.definitionFit: Along can mean alongside or by the side of, so it works for next to.

clue.text: Talk with French animal

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the French word for cat

explanation.walkthrough: The two meanings come from two languages: an English noun and a French one.
explanation.definitionFit: The same spelling is English for a casual conversation and French for a domestic cat.

clue.text: Heading west, it is incumbent on me to contain an oceanological disaster

indicators.note: in an across entry, heading west means the letters run right to left
the obligation phrase contains the small word

parts.note: a duty on me means I must
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone feels obliged to stop a seaborne catastrophe.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsunami is a huge sea wave, usually set off by an undersea earthquake, that floods coasts.

clue.text: Evil in-house degenerate

indicators.note: degenerate letters fall apart into a new order

parts.note: the hyphenated word supplies the letters as written

explanation.surface: A corrupt insider within an organization.
explanation.definitionFit: Heinous describes a shockingly wicked act, a strong word for wicked.

clue.text: Public srvant

definitions.meaning: the surface reading: a civil employee, as in public servant
the setter's reading: the word is missing its E, so for E it is a stranger

explanation.walkthrough: The deliberate misspelling is the wordplay: split the answer as FOR E STRANGER, since E is foreign to this servant.
explanation.definitionFit: A forest ranger is a government employee who protects woodland, so a civil worker.
